customer_question: How do we verify that our SIG Launchstudio account is set up correctly and linked to our company?
question_variants: Where do I find my account information on SIG Launchstudio?
How do I confirm which company my SIG account belongs to?
actual_issue: Customers sometimes need to verify their SIG account status and company association. The procedure is: navigate to launchstudio.bluetooth.com, click the 'My blue' icon (person/circle icon) in the top right corner, then select 'My account.' This shows the account details and company association.
plain_english_explanation: On SIG Launchstudio, account verification is done through the 'My blue' user icon at the top-right of the screen. Clicking it reveals a dropdown that includes 'My account,' which shows the account details, company membership, and role. This is a basic but frequently needed navigational step for customers who are unfamiliar with the Launchstudio interface.
consultant_answer: Go to launchstudio.bluetooth.com → click the 'My blue' icon (top right) → select 'My account' to verify account details and company association.
decision_logic:
1. Navigate to launchstudio.bluetooth.com.
2. Look for the 'My blue' user icon in the top-right corner.
3. Click it → select 'My account.'
4. Review displayed account details and company association.
final_recommendation: When a customer reports account issues or asks how to check their SIG account, direct them to the 'My blue' icon → 'My account' path on launchstudio.bluetooth.com.
risk_if_done_wrong: If a customer cannot find their account or is linked to the wrong company, they will not be able to create or manage Qualification Workspaces — blocking all registration activity.
search_aliases: how to check SIG account company
